title: Cold Session
creator: FOCUS & CO
caption: deep house, lounge, instrumental. Warm Rhodes and soft grand piano playing minor seventh and ninth chords, round low-passed bassline, laid-back 909 kick, crisp shuffled hi-hats, light shaker, a distant muted trumpet plays short soft phrases now and then. Elegant, smooth, late-night cocktail bar mood. Hi-fi studio mix, warm analog tape, wide stereo, clean low end, 120 bpm
structure: [Intro - filtered Rhodes and soft kick] [Instrumental - full groove] [Breakdown - piano and pads, no kick] [Instrumental - groove returns with trumpet] [Outro - elements fade out]
